notes: Run from the repository root with npm run eval:benchmarks.
This benchmark verifies plugin installation into a workspace marketplace and smoke-tests plugin discovery.

scenarios.title: Plugin install smoke test
scenarios.purpose: Verify agentic-sdlc can be installed into a benchmark workspace and exposes skill-based entry points.
scenarios.userInput: Inspect the installed agentic-sdlc plugin. Confirm that the plugin is available from the workspace marketplace and that knowledge-foundation plus the sdlc-start, sdlc-autonomous, sdlc-status, and sdlc-doctor skills are present. Do not run a full SDLC workflow.
successChecklist: The response identifies the agentic-sdlc plugin installation.
The response confirms knowledge-foundation is present.
The response confirms the agentic-sdlc run controls are skills, not slash commands.
The response does not start a full SDLC workflow.
